t1.generated_sql:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' THEN c.avail_status END) AS "상태",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' AND cc.name='Vendor' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS "제조사",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' THEN c.ipaddress END) AS "IP주소",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' THEN c.hostname END) AS "호스트명",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' AND cc.name='OSType' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS "OS종류",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Cpus' AND cc.name='LOGICALCORE' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS "CPU코어수"
FROM polestar.cmm_resource c
LEFT JOIN polestar.core_config_prop cc ON cc.configuration_id = c.resource_conf_id
WHERE c.resource_type IN ('server.Cpus', 'server.Server')
  AND c.dtime IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id)
LIMIT 10000;

MODEL — CPU 모델명 (예: Intel Xeon Gold 6248R)
LOGICALCORE — 논리 CPU 코어 수 (하이퍼스레딩 포함)
TotalSize — 총 물리 메모리 크기 (예: 62.1 GB)
SwapTotalSize — Swap 메모리 총 크기 (예: 3.9 GB)

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' THEN c.avail_status END) AS "상태",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' AND cc.name='Vendor' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS "제조사",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' THEN c.ipaddress END) AS "IP주소",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' THEN c.hostname END) AS "호스트명",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' AND cc.name='OSType' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS "OS종류",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Cpus' AND cc.name='LOGICALCORE' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS "CPU코어수"
FROM polestar.cmm_resource c
LEFT JOIN polestar.core_config_prop cc ON cc.configuration_id = c.resource_conf_id
WHERE c.resource_type IN ('server.Cpus', 'server.Server')
  AND c.dtime IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id)
LIMIT 10000;
